title.text: Map context: right-click card and tool ring

howDesk.text:
DESKTOP: try it in Play.
• Right-click (click) = context card
• Right-drag = ring. Flick fast and release: selects without drawing it
• Right-hold still ~0.3 s = ring AND card
• Hover map + hold Q = ring, aim, release Q
• Ctrl + right-drag with a sculpt/paint tool = brush size/strength
• Left-click = the armed tool (sculpt drafts, drop settlement, label…)
• Middle-drag pans. Esc closes/commits.

howTab.text:
TABLET: use a touchscreen or mouse.
• Press and hold 0.5 s: ring + card open at the finger
• Keep the finger down, slide to a slot, lift = select (marking)
• Lift in place = both stay open to tap
• Drag without holding = pan (or stroke if a sculpt tool is armed)
• Pen barrel / right button = card
• Toggle handedness in the top bar: the card moves away from your palm

howPhone.text:
PHONE:
• Long-press the map (0.48 s): drops the sample pin + peek sheet with 4 action chips
• Drag the sheet handle up for the full card; drag the pin to change subject
• Tool pill (bottom): tap = armed tool / Inspect; press and slide up = thumb fan, lift on a slot
• Tap the map to use the armed tool
• WORLD / CIVIL / CARTO tabs switch domain
